title: dryopteris subtriangularis
intro: Dryopteris subtriangularis, commonly known as the mountain wood fern, is a species of fern native to East Asia. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in reducing stress and improving overall well-being. Its therapeutic actions include its ability to soothe digestive issues and its potential in treating various cardiovascular diseases. The bioactive constituents of Dryopteris subtriangularis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
